create_dataset_loader: create an NvidiaDataset instance to load NVIDIA dataset images, poses, flows, and masks for training
calculate_average_poses: calculate the average camera pose from a set of poses using average_poses function
center_camera_poses: center camera poses around the average pose using center_poses for NDC coordinate conversion

resize_optical_flow: resize optical flow tensors to new dimensions using resize_flow while preserving motion vectors
